evals.prompt: I just joined the team. Explain how a webhook from Stripe ends up updating a subscription in our database in this repo. I'll be adding support for paused subscriptions next week.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads repo docs and manifests, finds the webhook entry point, traces the path to the DB write with file:line at each step, lists components and side effects, marks unverified claims, and ends with essential files, without jumping to refactor proposals.
expectations: Identifies the webhook route or handler with a file:line reference
Provides a numbered end-to-end trace from webhook to subscription DB write, each step with file:line
Notes side effects and error handling along the path (e.g. signature verification, retries, idempotency)
Marks at least the unverified claims as inferred, or verifies claims by running/reading a test
Does not propose refactors or bug verdicts before the map is complete

evals.prompt: Give me an architecture overview of this monorepo, I need to present it to the new hires tomorrow.
evals.expected_output: The agent fixes the depth (overview), reads docs, manifests, CI and git hot spots, identifies the packages/services and their entry points, and produces the structured map with glossary and essential files.
expectations: States the question and depth before exploring
Uses CI config or manifests to report real build/test commands
Uses git history to identify hot spots or recently active areas
Output follows the map structure (entry points, components, glossary, essential files)

evals.prompt: This codebase looks like garbage honestly. Before we plan the rewrite, tell me everything that's wrong with the order service.
evals.expected_output: The agent resists leading with verdicts: it first builds the map of the order service with evidence, then gives clearly labeled observations each backed by file references, noting what is inferred.
expectations: Builds the entry-point and trace map before listing problems
Observations are labeled as observations and each cites file:line evidence
Does not assert problems it has not seen in code
